name: slider-field
title: Slider field
description: A slider with its label, live value in the right unit, end labels, a default marker with reset and an exact-value box.
docs: value, defaultValue and onValueChange work as on any field; defaultValue is also the default, so a tick on the track marks it and a Reset button, which only exists while the value is somewhere else, puts it back. formatValue writes the value in your unit and is used in the readout, at the ends and in aria-valuetext, so a screen reader hears "45 min". showInput adds a number field beside the track: it follows the slider and the slider follows it, what is typed is clamped and stepped (counted from min, like the slider) when you leave the field or press Enter, Escape takes it back and the arrow keys step. onValueCommit fires once when a drag or a key press settles, for a save that should not run on every pixel. marks takes numbers or { value, label }; a labelled mark at an end replaces the end label. name sends the value with a plain form, and labels changes the words of the buttons. locale (default en-US) decides how the number field reads what is typed and how it writes the value while you edit: with en-US "3,000" is three thousand and "1,5" one and a half, with nl-NL "3.000" is three thousand. A sign that is not the decimal one of the locale groups only when it stands alone with three digits after it, behind a number that does not start with a zero.
